== Description ==

Tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025, with [[Logan Pietig]] (front left, black shirt and glasses), [[Karl Koenig]] (left, red sweater), and [[Taylor Gosiaco]] (right, navy shirt and glasses); other players unlabeled.
